thread:
maria: Kickoff: follow-up for the recurring streaming partial-response issues. Goal: one place for owners, acceptance criteria, and short-term mitigations.

chao: Summary from traces: most cases show idle TCP close on proxy -> client reconnect -> server final chunk dropped. Also saw our streaming handler drop when buffer.wait > 90s.

henry: My proposal: three parallel tracks - infra keepalive changes, safer reconnect semantics in SDKs, and a server-side graceful-finalization signal.

kate: I can take infra. Plan: switch proxy keepalive from 45s -> 240s in a controlled canary (eu-central-1), and enable TCP keepalive probes at kernel level. Will monitor fd usage and connection churn. ETA: 2026-05-01.

ryan: I'll own the SDK side. Add a reconnection backoff with exponential jitter and an idempotency header X-Req-Stream-Id so server can stitch or ignore duplicate streams. Will update JS and Python SDKs + docs. ETA: 2026-04-28.

maria: Server changes?

henry: I'll add: 1) explicit finalization event (stream:status=complete|partial|error) emitted as a terminal chunk, 2) increase internal streaming buffer timeout to 150s, with a feature flag to toggle. Also add server-side dedupe by X-Req-Stream-Id. ETA: 2026-04-30.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-99 created by maria, priority: P2.

kate: Observability - I'll create a dashboard for streaming.partial_end_rate and streaming.finalization_error_rate and a log span that ties RST/FIN counts to request IDs. ETA: 2026-04-26.

ryan: Testing: I'll add a chaos test to CI that simulates abrupt socket close at random offsets and asserts client receives finalization event or trailing-error token. ETA: 2026-04-27.

maria: Acceptance criteria please for tracking.

kate: Infra acceptance: canary shows <0.1% truncated streams under 48h and no >75% fd saturation.

ryan: SDK acceptance: clients perform safe reconnect with X-Req-Stream-Id, server dedupes, and no duplicate full completions observed in 72h of synthetic traffic.

henry: Server acceptance: finalization event present for all streams in tests; no buffer.timeouts in synthetic 5M token workloads; feature-flag documented and covered by unit tests.

maria: Great. PD/runbook?

kate: I'll add a runbook step: if streaming.finalization_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, page eng-runtime and set a short-lived rollback. PR will include runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-21 09:00 UTC: "streaming follow-up check-in" (weekly x2).

ryan: Quick concern: increasing keepalive might increase file descriptor usage. We'll autoscale proxy workers if fd>70%. Kate: noted — will include autoscale guard in canary.

henry: Also adding parser-level protection: trailing-error token will be a reserved JSON envelope {"__stream_status":"partial_error"} so clients can reliably detect non-content final chunks.

maria: Please drop PR links here when ready so we can attach to INC-2026-99.

ryan: SDK PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/420 (JS), https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/421 (Python).

henry: Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1004 - finalization event + buffer defaults behind feature flag.

kate: Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/312 - proxy keepalive canary + autoscale guard.

maria: Ops dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-monitoring/pull/72

ryan: CI chaos test PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/e2e-tests/pull/160 - includes socket-drop harness and assertions.

maria: OK owners + ETAs pinned. Weekly check-ins here. We'll consider resolving incident after all acceptance criteria pass + 7-day stability.

henry: I'll add unit + integration tests and post results to INC ticket.

kate: Canary started in eu-central-1. Posting fd and truncated-stream metrics in #eng-sre after 30m.

ops-bot: canary rollout notification for proxy keepalive in eu-central-1 (canary_id: cny-102).

maria: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the canonical follow-up channel.
